section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section summarizes the study's findings on the relationships between multiple dimensions of interoceptive awareness (IA) and various facets of body image. It highlights that distinct IA dimensions have unique relationships with body image, with the 'Trusting' subscale of MAIA demonstrating the strongest and most consistent positive relationship with body image variables, while 'Noticing' showed a negative association with body appreciation in regression models. The section also discusses limitations, such as the reliance on self-report measures and the cross-sectional design, and suggests clinical implications for targeted interventions.
